name: official_walk_adaptation_diagnostics
scope: Fixed-weight closed-loop simulation, one factor at a time; no training or hardware control

reference_repeat.hypothesis: Repeat the original adaptation with the current evaluator before comparing a changed factor.

runtime_home.hypothesis: Using runtime home consistently for both relative observations and target reconstruction may change gait initiation. All initial physical states remain unchanged.

runtime_filter.hypothesis: The archived action EMA may alter closed-loop behavior. Preserve the exact slices including policy index 9, and keep raw previous actions in observations.

actuator_kp6.hypothesis: The source-level P setting differs from the simulator's kp_fw. Changing only this simulator gain tests sensitivity, not equivalence to real P/D or proof of the cause.

comparison_rules: Create a fresh simulator for every variant; preserve dynamics randomization, noise, delays, initial state, commands and model.
Use all five original command conditions and all first episodes, including failures; do not change acceptance thresholds.
Recompute saved metrics independently; compare actual runtime home/filter math with the adapted inputs and applied actions.
Record raw actions, applied actions, requested joint targets and post-step physical joint states; these are separate quantities.
A diagnostic condition passing thresholds is not confirmation on a held-out seed or hardware validation.
